Join Us
Sundays · 9:00 AM In Person · Zoom 8:00 AM EST

The Church for the Uncompromised Word of God

Welcome to Inspired Word Apostolic Church in Newmarket, Ontario. We preach the undiluted Word of God with an emphasis on the Holy Spirit, holiness, and daily devotionals.

Join Us This SundayGive Online
Our Pastor & Mission

Rooted in the Uncompromised Word of God

Inspired Word Apostolic Church is a Bible-believing church in Newmarket, Ontario, led by Pastor Innocent Ariajegbe. We are dedicated to preaching the uncompromised, undiluted Word of God, with a steadfast focus on the Holy Spirit, holiness, and daily devotionals.

Learn More About Us
MINISTRY LIFE

Connect and Grow in Every Season

Find your place in our church family with vibrant ministries designed to strengthen faith, nurture fellowship, and bless our neighborhood.

Worship & Arts

Lifting heartfelt praise that ushers in God's presence every single service.

Learn more

Apostolic Youth

Equipping the next generation with unshakeable truth, passion, and true purpose.

Learn more

Outreach & Care

Serving local families through practical care, food drives, and community prayer.

Learn more
Explore All Ministries
SERVICE TIMES & MEETINGS

Service Times & Meetings

Join us every Sunday in Newmarket or online via Zoom for the uncompromised Word of God, prayer, and fellowship.

View Services
EVERY SUNDAY9:00 AM
Event Details

Sunday In-Person Service

Gather with us in person at 461 Park Ave., Newmarket, for heartfelt worship, apostolic preaching, and fellowship.

EVERY SUNDAY8:00 AM – 10:00 AM EST
Event Details

Sunday Virtual Service (Zoom)

Join our live Sunday service online from anywhere. Contact the church to receive the Zoom meeting link.

FEATURED SERMON

Stand Firm

Pastor Innocent AriajegbeWatch on YouTube

You have the full armor of God to stand firm in apostolic truth, divine victory, and unwavering faith.

Watch More Sermons

PLAN YOUR VISIT

Join Us in Person

We cannot wait to greet you at the doors. Our welcome team will help you find parking, settle in, and feel right at home.

Location

461 Park Ave.
Newmarket, ON, Canada

+1 905-505-0959

Service Times

  • Sunday In-Person Service9:00 AM
  • Sunday Zoom Service8:00 AM – 10:00 AM EST

item.title: About
item.dc:creator: willoughbyolamideemmanuel@gmail.com
item.content:encoded:
Join Us

About Our Church

A Bible-Believing Church in Newmarket

Inspired Word Apostolic Church (IWAC) is a Bible-believing Christian church in Newmarket, Ontario, led by Pastor Innocent Ariajegbe. We preach the uncompromised, undiluted Word of God with an emphasis on the Holy Spirit, holiness, and daily devotionals.

Everyone is welcome to worship with us Sundays at 9:00 AM at 461 Park Ave. in Newmarket, or join our virtual service on Zoom Sundays from 8:00 AM – 10:00 AM EST.

Foundation & Doctrine

Core Focus & Beliefs

The Uncompromised Word

Bible-believing and committed to preaching the undiluted Word of God.

The Holy Spirit

Centering ministry on the Holy Spirit's guidance, presence, and power.

Holiness

Emphasizing living a holy, dedicated life in obedience to scripture.

Daily Devotionals

Encouraging daily devotionals to keep God's Word central in everyday life.

Join Us for Worship

Service Times & Meetings

In-Person

Sundays at 9:00 AM

461 Park Ave., Newmarket, ON

Zoom Service

Sundays 8:00 AM – 10:00 AM EST

Contact us for the Zoom link

View All Services

PASTORAL LEADERSHIP

Meet Our Pastor

Senior Pastor

Pastor Innocent Ariajegbe

Inspired Word Apostolic Church

Pastor Innocent Ariajegbe leads Inspired Word Apostolic Church in Newmarket, Ontario, faithfully preaching the uncompromised, undiluted Word of God.

His ministry places a strong emphasis on the presence and power of the Holy Spirit, living a life of holiness, and cultivating daily devotionals. Sermons and teachings are shared regularly with the congregation, on YouTube, and across social media.

Watch on YouTubeContact the Church

Inspired Word Apostolic Church — The Church for the Uncompromised Word of God.

Quick Links

Service Times

Sunday In-Person: 9:00 AM
Sunday on Zoom: 8:00 AM – 10:00 AM EST
461 Park Ave., Newmarket, ON, Canada

Connect With Us

  • +1 905-505-0959
  • iwac2022@gmail.com
FacebookYouTube

© 2026 Inspired Word Apostolic Church. All rights reserved.

item.title: Sample Page
item.content:encoded:
This is an example page. It's different from a blog post because it will stay in one place and will show up in your site navigation (in most themes). Most people start with an About page that introduces them to potential site visitors. It might say something like this:

Hi there! I'm a bike messenger by day, aspiring actor by night, and this is my website. I live in Los Angeles, have a great dog named Jack, and I like piña coladas. (And gettin' caught in the rain.)

...or something like this:

The XYZ Doohickey Company was founded in 1971, and has been providing quality doohickeys to the public ever since. Located in Gotham City, XYZ employs over 2,000 people and does all kinds of awesome things for the Gotham community.

As a new WordPress user, you should go to your dashboard to delete this page and create new pages for your content. Have fun!

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.content:encoded:
Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: https://communal-kit.10web.cloud.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

item.title: Ministries
item.dc:creator: willoughbyolamideemmanuel@gmail.com
item.content:encoded:
Join Us
CHURCH MINISTRIES

Ministries That Serve Every Generation

Whether you are a child, student, young professional, or senior, there is an active place for you to belong, grow, and serve.

Children of the Word (Ages 0-11)

Safe, engaging, and fun biblical education nurturing a lifelong love for Jesus through stories, crafts, and praise.

Ignite Youth & Students (Ages 12-18)

Dynamic weekly gatherings, retreats, and mentorship encouraging teens to stand strong in truth and character.

Chosen Young Adults

A vibrant fellowship of college students and young professionals navigating careers, relationships, and faith together.

Men of Integrity

Monthly breakfasts, prayer vigils, and accountability partnerships fostering spiritual leadership in homes and communities.

Daughters of Grace Women's Fellowship

Uplifting sisterhood focused on prayer, spiritual growth, personal wellness, and community compassion initiatives.

Cornerstone Senior Saints

Cherished fellowship, scripture study, and pastoral visits honoring and engaging our seasoned church elders.

Inspired Word Apostolic Church — The Church for the Uncompromised Word of God.

Quick Links

Service Times

Sunday In-Person: 9:00 AM
Sunday on Zoom: 8:00 AM – 10:00 AM EST
461 Park Ave., Newmarket, ON, Canada

Connect With Us

  • +1 905-505-0959
  • iwac2022@gmail.com
FacebookYouTube

item.title: Services
item.dc:creator: willoughbyolamideemmanuel@gmail.com
item.content:encoded:
Join Us
SERVICE TIMES & MEETINGS

Join Us Every Sunday

Experience the uncompromised Word of God with our church family in Newmarket or connect with us online.

Inspired Word Apostolic Church

461 Park Ave., Newmarket, ON, Canada

Get Directions
+1 905-505-0959
Contact Church Office
EVERY SUNDAY
9:00 AM

In-Person Sunday Service

Join our worship gathering centered on prayer, praise, and preaching the uncompromised, undiluted Word of God. Everyone is welcome.

461 Park Ave., Newmarket, ON, Canada
Get Directions
EVERY SUNDAY
8:00 AM – 10:00 AM EST

Virtual Sunday Service (Zoom)

Can't make it in person? Join us online. Contact us for the Zoom link.

Online via Zoom
Request Zoom Link
Teachings & Fellowship

Daily Devotionals & Sermons

Inspired Word Apostolic Church emphasizes the Holy Spirit, holiness, and daily devotionals. Sermons and teachings are shared regularly on YouTube and social media.

Watch on YouTubeFollow on Facebook

Inspired Word Apostolic Church — The Church for the Uncompromised Word of God.

Quick Links

Service Times

Sunday In-Person: 9:00 AM
Sunday on Zoom: 8:00 AM – 10:00 AM EST
461 Park Ave., Newmarket, ON, Canada

Connect With Us

  • +1 905-505-0959
  • iwac2022@gmail.com
FacebookYouTube

© 2026 Inspired Word Apostolic Church. All rights reserved.

item.title: Give
item.dc:creator: willoughbyolamideemmanuel@gmail.com
item.content:encoded:
Join Us
Stewardship & Generosity

Support the Work of the Kingdom

Giving is an act of worship and gratitude. Your faithful tithes and sacrificial offerings fund weekly worship services, youth programs, missionary support, and community care outreaches.

“Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.”
— 2 Corinthians 9:7
All gifts are safe, encrypted, and recorded for church stewardship.

Loading donation form...

Inspired Word Apostolic Church — The Church for the Uncompromised Word of God.

Quick Links

Service Times

Sunday In-Person: 9:00 AM
Sunday on Zoom: 8:00 AM – 10:00 AM EST
461 Park Ave., Newmarket, ON, Canada

Connect With Us

  • +1 905-505-0959
  • iwac2022@gmail.com
FacebookYouTube

Join Us

WE'D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU

Get in Touch

Have questions about our church, need prayer, or planning your first visit? Send us a message and our pastoral care team will connect with you.
